Name: Brighter Dark Levels
Author: k3yboardFox
Description:
Are you tired of not being able to see anything in the dark levels of the mines? Of having to turn up your brightness for all the 30s only to be flashbanged by hitting level 40? I sure am! This mod turns the brightness up on the base game tilesets so you can finally see things hopefully (can also alter the dangerous mines).


Honestly it's probably ugly considering the "visual edits" were just cranking the exposure level but I just want this to exist, I can make it pretty in an update if I suddenly grow artistic talent (unlikely).

This mod can now effect [b]every[/b] floor of [b]every[/b] kind of mine with 2 different levels of brightening (bright or super bright). Some of the already bright levels (frost mines, desert) only have bright edits with no corresponding superbright, those are on a true / false toggle instead. Customize it however you need!
